name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands close together directly under your chest, forming a diamond or triangle shape with your index fingers and thumbs touching.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest down toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Descend until your chest nearly touches your hands.
Press back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Keep your core engaged throughout the movement.
This variation places greater emphasis on the triceps compared to standard push-ups.
